_comment: The private Skippy's projects (projects.py reads this). One entry per repo the Captain develops from his phone; each clones from its home, D:/trunk/git/<repo name>.git (docs/no-github.md), unless `remote` says otherwise. `clone` is the agent's own working copy (made by `git clone` on first use, never the Captain's checkout); `primary` is the Captain's checkout, which the agent may read (--add-dir) but works in only to deploy a skippy-pc service. Found 2026-09-30 from the origins of the repos directly under D:/Aaron/development (zPhone skipped: shelved; quarksum skipped: an older checkout of sigma-ground, whose CLAUDE.md calls it a dead end).
